summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload on install
details: @servicetitan/carto-react-kit@0.8.9 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-shaped blob (hex-named identifiers, shuffled constant array `n7gIxM`, string-array rotation dispatcher `WV8StW`, `@bun @bun-cjs` header) with no relation to its filename and no import path from the advertised library code in `dist/`. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern — fetching a second language runtime at install time specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload — evades Node-based review and runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's host on `npm install`. The library `dist/` matches the README's Carto React kit, but the preinstall dropper is grafted on and unrelated, consistent with a compromise of the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
